title: Revision questions: percentages, growth and ratio
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Seeded from mathematics/y11 lesson 57 (Revision exam-style question set (portal worksheet written for this lesson; original questions with mark-scheme answers))
intro: Lesson 57: Revision: percentages, growth and ratio. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: (a) Increase £360 by 17.5% (b) Write 48 as a percentage of 320 (c) A van worth £12,000 depreciates by 15% a year. Find its value after 3 years.
In the wider economy, an amount grows by r% compound interest each year, from £5,000 to £5,624.32 in 3 years. Find r.
A bag has red and green sweets in the ratio 5 : 3, 64 sweets in all. Some green sweets are added and the ratio becomes 5 : 4. How many were added?
questions.a: Red 40, green 24. 5 : 4 with red 40 gives green 32, so 8 added

questions.q: After a 12% increase, a price is £50.40. Find the original price.
A population of 8,000 falls by 2.5% a year. Find it after 3 years, to the nearest whole number.
a : b = 3 : 7 and b − a = 28. Find a + b.
£2,000 grows by 3% a year for 2 years. Find the final amount.
